Switch high-order and shock detector generation to the accepted claim-native backend while preserving scanner/Deep Scan authority and freezing reader publication IDs until Stage 7.

Activate claim-native wow, oddity, falsifier-ledger, trend-band and threshold selection after the Stage-6 detector switch; retire legacy publication carry without changing Scanner/Deep Scan authority.

Close the reasoning renovation with reader-language lint, applied downstream retrace/cleanup, zero-orphan integrity checks, evidence immutability verification, protected-core checks, and end-to-end regression validation.

Controlled Strand-A recall repair: admit trustworthy Tier-1/2 European R&I system evidence through the bounded evidence-led route without requiring explicit geopolitical wording; align Deep Scan with the same route; preserve hard source-integrity exclusions; update protected-core fingerprints after regression validation.

Strategic-gap discovery repair: reserve bounded front-of-queue scholarly discovery for clean industrial/energy/materials capability, commercialisation/private R&D, intra-European capability asymmetry, biotech/life sciences, and US/China dependency mechanisms; expand only the matching R&I-system ontology and authoritative EU source universe; explicitly align Deep Scan with those same state-variable examples; preserve all provenance, Europe, central-R&I and admission gates.

Source transport and first-party legal-source repair: identify the crawler for Crossref and blocked-source compatibility; try bare/www sitemap hosts; add configured institution RSS discovery without bypassing normal page/admission gates; use exact ISSN lookup for Science; stop normal partial-stage budgets from forcing degraded health; add bounded blocked-source news queries; and add a bounded first-party EUR-Lex/Cellar legal-act lane while preserving existing Strand-C gates.

Add bounded first-party European Parliament adopted-text discovery and persistent source-transport telemetry; preserve scan-to-Deep-Scan route parity by carrying scanner validation routes into ordinary and hard-core Deep Scan source retrieval; require Deep Scan and terminal recovery audits to explicitly exercise scanner_validation_route when one exists, and reject drop_unverifiable when that route succeeded; treat unscheduled and pre-request budget-skipped source checks as neutral; preserve existing admission and Deep Scan correctness gates.

Complete scan-to-validation route parity and selective publisher recall: keep first-party Cellar and European Parliament validation routes mandatory in ordinary and hard-core Deep Scan recovery; use an honest compatible Deep Scan crawler identity; add bounded exact DOI-prefix discovery only for RAND where current DOI activity and downstream validation are usable; mirror that route into the 24-minute Strand-A discovery scanner; leave blocked/metadata-sparse publisher prefixes out until substantive validation parity exists; preserve all ordinary A/B/C admission and source-integrity gates.
